mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with buprenorphine (opioid with monoaminergic activity) significantly increases risk of serotonin syndrome and potentially life-threatening CNS depression, respiratory depression, and hypotensive crisis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use lowest doses with intensive monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms, respiratory depression, and hemodynamic changes; consider alternative antidepressant.
